name: list-detail-page
useFor: Use for any list of records with a detail view (sites, reports, searches). Pass `sites`, `defaultSelected` and `onAsk`. On a phone the list sits above the detail.
constraints: Opening the detail in a modal on wide screens
source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: Figma UI · Agent chat (443:433), cited-fields, sources, site-chip, fit-score, status, tag
title: List detail page
description: Saved sites in the app shell: a filterable list (name, parcel ID in DM Mono, fit bar) beside the chosen site's name, coordinates, status, tags, survey plate, cited fields with sources and the composer with the site chip.
